FAQ

Frequently Asked Questions on Grievance Redress Mechanism in Government of India and the Role of Department of Administrative Reforms and Public Grievance, New Delhi, therein

1. What are the contact details of the Department of Administrative Reforms and Public Grievances?
2. Where can the grievances be sent?
3. How do I lodge the grievance?
4. What happens when I lodge the grievance?
5. How do I track my grievance?
6. What happens to the grievances? How are the grievances dealt with in Central Ministries/Departments?
7. After redress, can the grievance be re-opened for further correspondence about it having been closed without details etc.?
8. What are the contact details of the Nodal Officers of Public Grievances in Ministries/Departments?
9. What is the system of granting personal hearing on grievances?
10. What are the types of grievances which are not taken up for redress by the Department?
11. What is the role of Department of Administrative Reforms and Public Grievances (DARPG) with reference to the grievances concerning Central Ministries/Departments/ Organizations?
12. What is the role of Department of Administrative Reforms and Public Grievances (DARPG) with reference to the grievances concerning State Government?
13. What is the time limit for redress of grievance?
14. What action can be taken by me in case of non-redress of my grievance within the prescribed time?
15. What can a citizen do if he is not satisfied with the redressal of his grievance?
16. How to deactivate CPGRAMS account?
17. How to change the details of the Nodal Grievance Officer and Nodal Appellate Authority in the portal?
18. Whether the Department has operated any feedback call centre?
